scientific_objective: 在不新增 p2_y中心值 的情况下，本轮基线性能表现如何？

parameters.note: Precompute and archive aligned time series: LHAASO shadow metrics (hourly), ACE solar wind speed (1-min → 1-h avg), and magnetospheric indices (Kp, B-field components) on common UTC timestamps with nanosecond precision.
Validate temporal stationarity of LHAASO offset distribution over the candidate period (2021–2023) using Kwiatkowski–Phillips–Schmidt–Shin (KPSS) test (α=0.05).
Log all timestamp alignment offsets >30s between LHAASO event reconstruction and ACE telemetry as metadata for uncertainty propagation in subsequent hypothesis-driven candidates.

notes: All magnetic field and Kp features must be interpolated to LHAASO observation timestamps (UTC) using cubic spline; missing values beyond 2h gap imputed via forward-fill + linear interpolation.
LHAASO shadow offset must be computed relative to J2000 ecliptic north, corrected for geomagnetic cutoff rigidity drift using NMDB-adjusted cutoff model v2.1.
Baseline evaluation must report R², MAE, and directional accuracy (sign agreement of ΔVsw prediction vs. ACE/SWEPAM truth) at each target lead time.
